scripts.build: npm run build --workspace taurusdb-core && npm run build --workspace taurusdb-mcp
scripts.check: npm run build --workspace taurusdb-core && npm run check --workspace taurusdb-core && npm run check --workspace taurusdb-mcp
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspace taurusdb-core && npm run test --workspace taurusdb-mcp
scripts.kms:encrypt: npm run build --workspace taurusdb-core && node scripts/kms-encrypt-password.mjs
scripts.keychain:configure: npm run build && node packages/mcp/dist/index.js credentials configure
scripts.credentials:configure: npm run build && node packages/mcp/dist/index.js credentials configure
scripts.credentials:check: npm run build && node packages/mcp/dist/index.js credentials check
scripts.pack:check: npm pack --workspace taurusdb-core --dry-run && npm pack --workspace taurusdb-mcp --dry-run
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm test && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm run pack:check
